pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.body:
MVQueen Privacy Policy

Effective Date: [DATE]

This Privacy Policy explains how MVQueen (“MVQueen,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, shares, and protects information when you visit or shop through our website.

Information We Collect

We may collect information you provide when placing an order, creating an account, contacting us, joining our email list, or otherwise interacting with the store. This may include your name, contact information, shipping and billing information, order information, and communications.

We may also receive technical information such as device, browser, approximate location, IP address, and website activity through cookies and similar technologies.

How We Use Information

We use information to process and fulfill orders, provide customer support, communicate with you, improve our website and services, maintain security, prevent fraud, and send marketing communications where permitted and according to your preferences.

Service Providers

We may share information with Shopify, payment processors, shipping providers, analytics providers, email providers, technology providers, and other service providers that help us operate the store.

Cookies

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies for essential functionality, preferences, analytics, and marketing. You can manage available browser or privacy controls.

Your Choices and Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have privacy rights regarding access, correction, deletion, portability, or certain uses of your personal information. Contact us at [SUPPORT EMAIL] to request assistance.

Data Retention and Security

We retain information as reasonably necessary for business, legal, accounting, security, and operational purposes. We use reasonable safeguards, but no internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure.

Children

Our store is not intended for children under the age required by applicable law to provide consent to online services.

Contact

Privacy questions may be sent to [SUPPORT EMAIL].

pages.body:
MVQueen Terms of Service

Effective Date: September 24, 2026

These Terms govern your use of the MVQueen website and purchases made through it. By using the website, you agree to these Terms.

Products and Orders

Product descriptions, images, pricing, availability, and other information may change. We reserve the right to correct errors and to cancel or limit an order when necessary, including where information or availability is inaccurate.

Payments

Orders are processed through Shopify and available payment providers. You agree to provide accurate billing, shipping, and contact information.

Shipping and Delivery

Processing, shipping, delivery estimates, and any applicable customs or duties are described in our Shipping Policy. Delivery estimates are not guarantees unless expressly stated.

Returns and Refunds

Returns, exchanges, and refunds are governed by our Return & Refund Policy.

Intellectual Property

MVQueen names, logos, original text, graphics, photography, designs, site presentation, and other original brand materials are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws. You may not copy, reproduce, distribute, modify, scrape, republish, or commercially exploit MVQueen materials without written permission, except as permitted by law.

Third-Party Content

Some products, images, descriptions, services, or links may involve third parties. We do not claim ownership of third-party intellectual property and will address legitimate rights-holder concerns appropriately.

Acceptable Use

You may not misuse the website, interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorized access, introduce malicious code, or use the website for unlawful purposes.

Limitation and Disclaimers

To the extent permitted by law, the website and its content are provided subject to applicable disclaimers and limitations. Nothing in these Terms excludes rights that cannot legally be excluded.

Changes

We may update these Terms from time to time. Updated Terms become effective when posted unless otherwise required by law.

Contact

Questions may be sent to miss.mvqueen@gmail.com.

pages.title: Refund & Returns Policy
pages.body:
MVQueen Refund & Returns Policy

Effective Date: September 24, 2026

We want you to feel confident shopping with MVQueen. Our return window, eligibility requirements, exclusions, return process, and refund timing are set out below.

Return Window

Eligible items may be requested for return within 30 days of delivery.

Eligibility

Returned items must generally be unused, unworn, unwashed, undamaged, and returned with any original packaging or tags required by our policy. Certain hygiene-sensitive, beauty, cosmetic, intimate, personalized, final-sale, or otherwise restricted products may be non-returnable where permitted by law.

How to Request a Return

Contact miss.mvqueen@gmail.com with your order number and reason for the request before sending anything back. Do not send returns to an address until we provide return instructions.

Return Shipping

For eligible returns, MVQueen provides a return authorization and prepaid return label. Please wait for return instructions before sending an item back.

Refunds

After an approved return is received and inspected, an eligible refund will be issued to the original payment method, subject to the terms of this policy. Processing time may vary by payment provider.

Damaged or Incorrect Orders

Contact miss.mvqueen@gmail.com promptly with your order number and clear photos if an item arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect.

Contact

miss.mvqueen@gmail.com

pages.title: Shipping Policy
pages.body:
MVQueen Shipping Policy

Effective Date: September 24, 2026

Processing

Orders generally require approximately 1–3 business days to process before shipment. Processing times can vary by product and destination.

Delivery

Estimated transit time is approximately 5–8 business days after processing. Estimates can change because of carrier delays, weather, holidays, customs, or other circumstances outside our control.

Tracking

When tracking is available, tracking information will be provided to the email address associated with the order.

Multiple Shipments

Items in the same order may ship separately when products are fulfilled from different locations.

International Orders

Customers may be responsible for customs charges, duties, taxes, or other destination-specific fees where applicable.

Address Accuracy

Please verify your shipping address before completing an order. Contact miss.mvqueen@gmail.com as soon as possible if you identify an error, although changes cannot be guaranteed after an order enters fulfillment.

Contact

Shipping questions may be sent to miss.mvqueen@gmail.com.
